subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity logs for SOC 2 (Veridian Health)

Cc: security@veridianhealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Admin activity evidence for SOC 2 assessment (Veridian Health)

Hi David,

We're preparing for our SOC 2 readiness review and need to collect admin activity evidence from Redwood for the period 2024-01-01 through 2025-04-30. Specifically we'd like:

- A complete export of admin activity (role changes, console/portal actions, API key creations/revocations, privileged session starts/stops, service-account activity).
- Schema/field definitions for each event type.
- A hash-signed manifest and checksums for all exported files.
- Details on retention windows and the mechanism you're using to produce the export (stream vs snapshot).

Preferred delivery: SFTP or presigned S3. If neither is possible, please outline alternate secure transport and packaging.

Can you confirm scope, timeline (we're hoping to ingest evidence by 2025-06-02), and the point of contact for any follow-ups?

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alice Fisher
Security Manager | Veridian Health
security@veridianhealth.com

Hi Alice — thanks for the note.

Confirming receipt and tentatively assigning Marissa as evidence lead and Karthik for export orchestration. A few quick clarifying questions before we prepare the bundle:

1) Scope: do you want the raw event lines (JSON) for each admin action, or parsed CSV-friendly rows? We can provide both, but need to know which you will ingest.
2) Redaction: any fields you need redacted (e.g., query params, request bodies, PII)? Our default export redacts querystring parameters and request payloads unless you request otherwise under an NDA.
3) Delivery: S3 presigned URL + manifest or SFTP? If SFTP, we'll need host details and a PGP public key for encryption.

We'll aim to deliver an initial snapshot within 7 business days after you confirm the above.

-David

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Fisher <alice.fisher@veridianhealth.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Admin activity export — format, retention, and transport options

Hi Alice — looping in implementation details below. Long version, short: we can produce a timeboxed, attested export that meets SOC 2/SIG expectations; below are the options and a recommended default.

What we log (summary):
- Authentication events: successful/failed sign-ins, MFA challenges, token exchanges (actor, timestamp, source IP).
- Authorization changes: role grants/revokes, group membership changes, permission edits (actor, target, timestamp, change delta).
- Privileged operations: API key creation/revocation, service-account key rotations, console-approved elevation events.
- Configuration/route changes: model routing edits, scaling policy changes, autoscale triggers (user or automation actor, timestamp, before/after).
- Operator actions: live session starts/stops, CLI/admin tool invocations, RBAC changes.

Export fields (recommended CSV + raw JSON bundle):
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- event_type
- actor_email
- actor_internal_id (redwood id)
- target_resource
- action (create/update/delete/exec)
- request_path
- ip_address
- user_agent
- outcome (success/fail)
- request_payload_summary (redacted)
- raw_event_json (optional, included in zipped raw bundle)

Retention and sampling policy:
- Default retention: 90 days for standard hosted customers.
- Enterprise retention: configurable up to 2 years when contractually agreed. For Veridian we can enable 13 months (aligned to your security policy) as requested.
- For very large windows we support manifested time-slices (monthly tar.gz bundles) and ad-hoc delta exports.

Delivery options (pick one):
A) Presigned S3: we stage encrypted tar.gz files containing monthly CSV + raw_events NDJSON + manifest.json. We provide a SHA256 manifest and signed-attestation.txt (PGP-signed by Redwood compliance).
B) SFTP: we can push to your host with PGP encryption. We'll need your SFTP host, username, and PGP public key.
C) Secure HTTPS pull: time-limited, authenticated download links with signed manifest (less common for large archives).

Packaging & verification:
- Files: admin-activity-2024-01_2025-04.tar.gz
- Contents: monthly/ admin_activity_2024-01.csv, admin_activity_2024-01.raw.ndjson, manifest.csv, checksums.sha256, signed-attestation.txt
- Verification: checksums.sha256 + signed-attestation.txt (RSA 4096) and HMAC keyed by customer-specific secret when required.

Attachments: I've attached a sample manifest CSV (admin_activity_manifest.csv) and a short handoff doc (export_instructions.md) showing field names and an example row.

If that aligns, David will schedule the export and I will kick off the packaging. If you prefer SFTP, please share host + PGP key.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

If you can get a snapshot to us by 2025-05-30 (initial sample) and the full bundle by 2025-06-02 that would fit our review timeline.

Appreciate it,
Alice
